# Pull request

## Description

Describe the scenario, contribution type, and change.

## Gallery impact

Link the affected sample folder or explain which gallery experience changes.

## Validation

- [ ] I kept this pull request focused on one sample or one logical change.
- [ ] I tested the sample or documentation using the documented steps.
- [ ] The README explains prerequisites, setup, usage, limitations, and best-effort support status.
- [ ] The README ends with the correct sample-specific visitor tracker.
- [ ] `assets/sample.json` is complete and matches the README and folder identity.
- [ ] New samples include a local, sample-specific static PNG with meaningful alt text.
- [ ] Dates, author attribution, source URL, download URL, and thumbnails are current.
- [ ] I removed secrets, personal data, customer content, and tenant-specific values.
- [ ] I ran the relevant repository validation and addressed its results.

## Screenshots or output

Provide safe, non-sensitive evidence when the change affects rendered output.
